keyFindings.description: Since the merge, the check uses main's attachAskStates, which writes results[i].Ask row by row and then reads resolved asks' last answers from events. When that second read fails (for example the check's 5 s allowance ends during it), resolved asks keep State resolved with Answer nil. fillRelatedItems only logs and goes on, so the client prints 'Ask: closed with no answer: retracted' for an ask a person answered. The deep review reproduced this with an overlay test: events locked, a 1 s context, ask = {State:resolved Answer:<nil>}. The branch's own helper before the merge set nothing on error. Fix: on error, clear Ask on every candidate (or make the helper set states only once both reads succeed), and add a test that pins it. The comment at :666 and the contract comment on WriteSuggestion.ask must say ask is absent when it could not be read.

The merge brought main's renderer of the same SearchAsk wire type (search-answer.ts askStateLines, #2363). The client now has two renderers that word one state differently (dispatch search: 'Closed with no answer: <kind> by <actor> at <t>: <reason>'; the check: 'Ask: closed with no answer: <kind>', with no who, when or why). The bundler had to rename one to askStateLines2 in every dist file. Export main's renderer and call it from the check's item and decision lines, then delete related-check.ts:166-203. Update the pinned strings and the envoy-client fragment.

DecodeAskAnswer and DecodeAskResolution were exported for the branch's own search_ask.go, which the merge dropped. Only ScanAsk in the same file calls them now. Restore main's ask_row.go, so the PR's diff for that file is empty.
